## Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused on one concern and reviewable
- [ ] Preserves confirmed product decisions (PRD) — or links the approved change
- [ ] Does not implement unapproved future features
- [ ] Puzzle logic remains independent of Flame / Flutter
- [ ] No business logic in rendering components
- [ ] No hardcoded screen coordinates
- [ ] Levels/content remain configuration-driven
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated for puzzle domain changes
- [ ] No new dependencies, or each new dependency is justified below
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, Firebase config or signing files committed
- [ ] No build outputs or generated binaries committed
- [ ] Documentation updated (and ADR added for architectural decisions)
